title: Stop requiring producers to run the full test suite; fix stale docs
summary: Redo job 20261023-234313-h49d from the base, because the earlier changes were discarded. Producers run targeted tests, and run.rs no longer sends a report back for lacking a full `cargo test --locked` result. Athena's post-producer fmt, clippy and full-suite checks stay. This time every doc that states the old rule is amended, including the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] D95 entry and D103 and D95 in decisions.md. The audience is Athena operators and producers.

defaults_applied.how: cargo test, clippy and fmt must be clean, with no unused-code warnings left by the removed gating.
Lifecycle tests show that a report with no full-suite check goes to the verifier without a send-back, and that a failing recorded check still rejects.
A repo-wide search for the old wording is run over the docs and prompts, and every match is fixed.
The decision text is written for an outside reader, and the reason is stated once.
The figures cited in the docs come from the two jobs.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The repository is at the base, so the full change is redone, not only the CHANGELOG fix.
The reason is stated with the figures from the two jobs: nvbb ran the suite six times and hit its 1800 s deadline; a run takes 9 to 11 minutes.
The new decision is D113, which amends D95 and D103, and D95 and D103 each get a forward pointer to it.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md no longer tells the producer to run or report the full `cargo test --locked`. It says to run targeted tests (`cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`) while working and that Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite on the candidate.

In crates/athena-core/src/run.rs the producer loop no longer sends a report back for lacking a real full-suite result. The `ran_full_tests` and `tests_missing` gating and its send-back text are removed. The send-back for unmet acceptance criteria is kept. The producer-report-gaps note no longer tells the verifier to run the full suite.
The checks Athena runs on the candidate (fmt, clippy, full test) and their effect on the verdict are unchanged. The verifier prompt still says to cite recorded results.

Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle` and `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test job_plan`. A producer report with no full-suite check, or with `not-run`, goes to the verifier without a send-back. A report with unmet criteria is still sent back once. A candidate whose recorded test check fails is still rejected.
Run `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`. Both are clean.

docs/decisions.md has a new decision, D113, amending D95 and D103. The D95 and D103 entries each get a pointer forward to D113. D113 states once that the earlier text stays as history, and gives the reason with the figures: nvbb ran the suite six times and hit its 1800 s deadline, and a run takes 9 to 11 minutes.

CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased], including the D95 entry near line 624, no longer says the producer must run the full suite. The old entry is amended or marked superseded by D113, and a D113 entry is added. docs/design/athena-v0.md no longer says it either. A grep of decisions.md, athena-v0.md and CHANGELOG.md for 'full `cargo test --locked`', 'second miss' and 'ran_full_tests' finds no statement of the requirement outside quoted history. The criterion evidence cites that search command and its output.

out_of_scope: Changing the fmt, clippy and full-suite checks Athena runs on the candidate.
Adding a new pre-handover search check to the producer stage, which is a separate piece of work.
Changing the verifier's commands or its verdict rules.
departures: The change spans prompt, code, tests and several docs, and the full test suite must run cold (9 to 11 minutes) in verification, so cost and time are above the reference.
